title: Terminal and Colony Again
author: Coral Dunmore
blurb: Juniper Marchetti, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
